summary: Describes a way to tell RTP receivers when packets are sent at a time other than their nominal transmission time. It also provides a way for receivers to give better jitter reports that account for those offsets. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a sender mails a packet earlier or later than it should. This adds a note saying so, so the receiver doesn't think the post office is at fault.

questions: rtp jitter reports with timing offsets
